# make new: beta builds

Moved verbatim from `CLAUDE.md` to keep that file lean. Read it only when working on this topic.

  - **Beta builds**: a brand-new major with no stable release yet (e.g. right after it's announced) only has pre-release tags on Docker Hub, named like a hotfix build plus a literal `-beta` suffix — `vX.Y.Z-beta`, `vX.Y.Z.W-beta` (confirmed live; no numbered variants like `-beta2`). These are excluded from the normal stable-tag fetch, same as `rc`/`alpha`. Only when that fetch comes back **empty** does the script fall back to listing beta tags and asking "Use a beta build instead?" — a major that already has any stable release never shows its betas, so this can't accidentally steer someone away from a real release. On accepting, `tag_minor()` strips the `-beta` suffix before grouping (so `v1.65.0.1-beta` groups under minor `1.65.0` same as a stable hotfix would), and the minor/build menus get a `(beta, ...)` label so it's never ambiguous which mode is active. The floating `.x` tag (e.g. `1.65.0.x`) already exists as a real Docker Hub tag even pre-stable and needs no special handling — Metabase publishes it to track the latest beta patch, then presumably continues tracking stable patches once released.
